title: Serialized prescribed-head timing-fixture qualification
purpose: Select a transactionally valid prescribed-head transient for application-level paired timing without using adaptive performance outcomes in fixture selection.
selection_rule: Evaluate analytical default-off only. Select the first candidate in listed order that completes and commits with complete mass accounting and abs mass residual <=1e-12. Adaptive results and timing are forbidden during selection.
failure_rule: If none completes, Stage-2 application timing remains blocked; do not loosen temporal or mass gates.
